text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing a meeting in the trainer's 
office, I was walking with Believe when—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, whatever should I do...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Believe-chan and Trainer-san. The 
sushi tub is leaking, you see."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I came to borrow a replacement, but all 
the cooks were out, so I couldn't get one.
choice_data_list:
A sushi tub? Were you just about to make 
sushi?
A sushi tub? Were you about to make sushi?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Hey, Believe-chan, do you remember? 
The other day in class, City-chan—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san. When I had to leave early for 
work last week, you packed me a thick 
sushi roll, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That was super delicious. I polished off a 
whole stick in no time.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real? That much? Aww, I wanna eat it 
too!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Mm. I might want to eat some again too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, that makes me so happy. I'll be 
sure to make enough for everyone next 
time, then.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"I promised to bring it tomorrow, you see. 
I even prepped the ingredients yesterday."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... There's no helping it. I suppose 
I'll just have to make it in a bowl...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Could you let me see the sushi tub? I 
might be able to fix it...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the hoop has come loose. I 
should be able to fix something like this.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Really? That helps a lot. You really do 
need a sushi tub to mix the rice properly, 
after all.
choice_data_list:
It really makes that big of a difference, 
huh.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...The wood of the tub absorbs the 
moisture. That's why even when you mix in 
the vinegar, the rice doesn't get soggy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Checking repeatedly, Believe tightened the 
hoops and restored the sushi oke tub to 
its original, well-balanced shape.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Believe-chan, thank you so much for 
fixing it! Ehehe, it looks good as new."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san. I'll help make the futomaki 
too.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
When it's enough to feed the entire class, 
even just the rice adds up to quite a 
massive amount.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Well then, shall we cook the rice?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mix the seasoned vinegar into 
freshly cooked rice, the vinegar won't 
evaporate properly, leaving it too sour.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
The rice is the most important part of 
sushi. So, I was thinking of cooking it in 
an earthenware pot, but—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Let's prepare the ingredients, then. Heat 
transfers differently depending on the 
clay pot, so it's probably best for 
Acute-san to cook the rice.
choice_data_list:
Does that mean you usually use an 
earthenware pot too, Believe?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes, whenever I cook for myself. It 
doesn't take any longer than a rice cooker 
would, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"No, even if the time is the same, you can 
leave a rice cooker unattended. Always 
cooking in an earthenware pot—even knowing 
it tastes better—isn't something just 
anyone can manage."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
These dried gourd strips and dried 
shiitake mushrooms... Did you simmer them, 
Acute-san?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Last night, actually. Soak it in 
water to rehydrate it before you head off 
to school.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I see. Same here. I do the prep work the 
day before. My grandmother taught me that 
letting it sit overnight brings out the 
flavor better.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right~. That's why it inevitably 
takes two whole days to make, you see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thick sushi rolls, two whole days... 
Despite the abundance of convenient 
alternatives, the level of dedication here 
is staggering.
choice_data_list: You put a lot of effort into your cooking!
You put a lot of effort into your cooking!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? I'm simply making it the 
same way my grandmother does.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
City-chan taught me about it. She says 
it's called "mindful living."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
While I was letting the boiling water cool 
to the right temperature to brew tea, 
someone asked me if you're the same way, 
Believe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. The temperature really 
does make all the difference in taste.
choice_data_list: Even your daily life is so craftsman-like!

So living like that is what's "normal" for 
you, Believe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going the extra mile to make something 
delicious is a mindset shared with 
craftsmen.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I've never really made a conscious 
effort to be 'meticulous,' but..."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, their ways of thinking might be 
quite similar.
choice_data_list:
Haha, you're a true artisan at heart, 
aren't you!

Fufu, you really are a craftsperson to the 
core!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, as I happened to pass by 
Believe's classroom...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Living with my grandparents is truly 
the foundation of my life.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, Believe-chan and I really hit it 
off during the dorm's deep cleaning, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I scattered used tea leaves and swept the 
hallway. And then, I polished the floor 
with coffee grounds.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Though it's all just me 
copying my grandmother. I feel like I 
share a similar way of thinking with 
Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While pleasantly chatting about handy life 
hacks, the two of them rolled a great deal 
of thick sushi rolls.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, as I happened to pass by 
Believe's classroom...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, futomaki really is delicious. Thanks 
for not making it too sweet, too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, so good! The ingredients are so 
simple, so why's it this delicious?!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Each grain of rice stands distinct—neither 
too firm nor too soft. The ingredients are 
fragrant as well. One can truly sense the 
meticulous care reminiscent of a 
first-rate traditional restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't that wonderful? Right, 
Believe-chan?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...I didn't do anything. It was all Ms. 
Acute's work."
